governing_question_after_every_piece_of_: Did this materially move Constitutional Capitalism toward a finished system?
organizing_principle: Literally build a path forward for the State of Arkansas — from today's balance sheet and operating system to the proposed state.
build_strategy: Breadth first. Completeness second. Depth third. Proof fourth.
stage_3_discipline: Finish vertically inside the active category. Do not research horizontally into unfinished categories.

historical_metric_reconciliation.legacy_role: Historical research / governance / website / evidence composite — useful archive, no longer the governing completion signal
historical_metric_reconciliation.rule: Do not erase 43; do not treat it as Stage completion. Dashboard four bars + overall_project_completion become source of truth after module inventory.

stages.name: Full Skeleton
stages.target: Every component and relationship exists — 100% structural coverage
stages.exit_gate: Draw the entire Constitutional Capitalism system on one master architecture and point to where every major function of government, markets, households, communities, capital, and democratic power lives — no orphan areas.
stages.current_work: COMPLETE — Pass 5 Whole-System Closure Audit certified Stage 1 at 100% skeleton (CC-DEC-157). Horizontal expansion frozen.
stages.after_ten_locks: Superseded by five-pass plan; Pass 5 closed Stage 1

stages.name: Full First Pass
stages.target: Every component has an actual working model — 100% of modules at FIRST_PASS (15-field standard)
stages.exit_gate: Every module has minimum viable substance under the 15-field Stage 2 standard — expert-handable, not dissertation.
stages.rule: No polishing while another category sits empty. Measure: working modules / 50.

stages.name: Unabridged Completion
stages.target: Every category written to exhaustive Volume I source-of-truth quality
stages.current_work: Pass 3.6 Arkansas Productive Systems COMPLETE. Next: Pass 3.7 Transition & Intergenerational Arkansas only.
stages.exit_gate: Category-by-category unabridged completeness: 100% of Category N before starting Category N+1.
stages.rule: Finish one category at a time. Dig deep inside the active category. Route sideways discoveries to later passes. No arbitrary page limit.
stages.volume: Volume I — Unabridged Constitutional Capitalism System

stages.name: Validation / Break It
stages.exit_gate: System survives ruthless attack; every failure resolves PASS | MODIFY | REPLACE | REMOVE.

stages.name: Public Book
stages.target: Compress the validated system into the ~100-page public roadmap (Volume II)
stages.exit_gate: Reader can travel Where Arkansas is → why outcomes → what changes → money flows → household life → transition → what Arkansas could become, with pointers into Unabridged.

stages.name: Implementation Manuals
stages.target: Administration-specific plans, legislative packages, agency transitions, local pilots, fiscal schedules, dashboards
stages.exit_gate: Future Arkansas administration can execute without inventing the missing middle.

questions: Completion movement: Did I advance a stage exit gate?
Scope discipline: Did I prevent unnecessary expansion?
Coverage discipline: Did I catch a missing structural issue rather than blindly rushing forward?
Depth discipline: Did I stop research when additional depth stopped affecting architecture?
Integration: Did the new work connect to the existing system instead of becoming another island?
Decision rate: Did we turn uncertainty into decisions?
Writing completion: Did we increase the amount of genuinely finished material?
manager_scorecard.failure_condition: If none of these move, the completion objective failed — even if research was fascinating.
